messages.text: That refund is what I want. Actually, I’ve cancelled the request because my partner had already arranged a replacement with the seller. Will anything still be paid?

If you cancelled using the cancel button on the proposal card, the request will not be paid. If you only said so in chat, please use that button—chat messages do not cancel requests. I won’t proceed with payment while cancellation is unresolved. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
